From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: integration fit — streaming, funcalls, embeddings (next steps)

Thanks again for taking the call today — appreciated the clear signal on priorities. I wanted to capture what we heard and propose a tight next-step plan so things stay momentum-driven. Summary below, then a short POC scope and owners. Attachment: redwood-proposal-digest.pdf (two-page summary).

Summary of customer pain / goals (what you told us)
- Inference latency spikes on peak clinical hours (30–90s for multi-step flows) — affects provider UX.
- Embedding reranker currently inconsistent across long clinical notes; need more stable reranking and relevance.
- Need structured extraction (ICD codes, meds) from free-text with deterministic output for downstream systems.
- Must meet HIPAA controls: VPC or Private deployment, audited logs, data residency in us-east.

Proposed technical approach (high level)
1) SDK + streaming: use continuous streaming for long transcripts to reduce perceived latency and start rendering partial results while models finish.
2) Function-calling for structured ops: map extraction tasks to structured function outputs (JSON schema) to avoid brittle parsing; we'll provide the schema template and runtime hooks.
3) Embeddings + reranker: two-stage pipeline — approximate retrieval with dense embeddings, then model-based rerank (compact reranker model) to improve precision on notes >8k tokens.
4) Private/Dedicated options: recommend Dedicated for initial POC (predictable throughput) and then evaluate Private (VPC) during security review.

POC scope (30 days suggested)
- 2 endpoints: (A) streaming-funcall pipeline for note ingestion + structured extraction; (B) embedding+rerank for search.
- Success metrics: median latency <2s first-token for streaming UX; reranker precision lift +8% on your eval set; structured extraction F1 > 0.86 (per current labeled set).
- Deliverables: integration guide, sample SDK patch, small infra runbook for Dedicated.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Leah: share a representative sample (anonymized) of 200 notes and your current rerank eval set (link or S3).
- Novus: confirm whether Dedicated or Private is required for the POC (billing/pricing impact).
- SRG (we): prepare a scoped cost estimate and SOC2/HIPAA artifacts.

Who will own what
- Ben (me): POC timeline, demo, technical alignment.
- Monica: pricing sketch and legal/commercial coordination.
- Sergio: security questionnaire and SOC2 artifacts; will be primary security contact.

Proposed schedule
- By EOD Wed (07/28): Redwood provides draft POC plan + pricing sketch (attached map-of-actions).
- Week of 08/02: kickoff (1-hour tech sync) and sample data handoff.

Quick ask: are you available for a 30–45 minute kickoff next Tue (08/03) morning PT? If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the proposed agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast on this.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-proposal-digest.pdf, integration-quick-arch.json

Subject: Re: Post-call: integration fit — streaming, funcalls, embeddings (next steps)

Thanks Ben — this aligns with our notes. A couple clarifications from our side before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Deployment model: For PHI handling we need either Private (VPC) or Dedicated with BYOK + audit logs. For the POC we'd prefer Dedicated to move faster, but we need to validate that logs/traces can be routed to our Splunk instance. Is that supported out of the box?

2) Data: We'll produce an anonymized sample of 200 notes (target Wed 07/28) — can we upload to an S3 bucket you provide? We also need to confirm retention behavior during the POC (default retention window, and deletion on request).

3) Compliance artifacts: please include your SOC 2 Type II attestation and any HIPAA-related attestations in the materials you send Wed. Also need a short data flow diagram for our InfoSec review.

4) Pricing: high-level ballpark for a 30-day POC with Dedicated capacity (GPU estimate + per-token) would be helpful for our procurement to start internal approval — non-binding is fine.

We can do Tue 08/03 9:30–10:15 AM PT for the kickoff. Please send invite.

-Leah
Sr. PM, Search & Retrieval | Novus Health
